cases.subject: EntityCompositionService / ObserverReactionBoundary
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Caller owns rejected detached actors; World owns accepted actors. RegistrationScope is transient and disconnects both World signals, clears notifications/activity at finish. No recurring cache.

cases.subject: WorldSnapshotService
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Temporary validation/rejection actors are Nodes freed by this operation, accepted actors transfer to World. Mutable records/plans are transient Resources; no free(Resource). Capture does not preserve live Object/RID references.

cases.subject: PhysicsGrabTarget
cases.ownership_and_verdict: World owns proxy Node; physical body metadata stores WeakRef. Deferred one-shot body-exit callback binds weak proxy/original World and checks registry/expiry. Tested in persistent World; no surviving proxies/orphans.

cases.subject: CartCargoSolver / GrabPhysicsSolver
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Borrow PhysicsDirectBodyState only for native callback; store transforms/sample values, not native state references. Relationships own bindings; release restores native collision/integrator state. No static cache.

cases.subject: CustomerInspectionService
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Reuses customer-owned child slot, registers once, removes parcel/cargo/booth Relationships at end. World retires consumed contents. Sixty begin/end cycles in same World are stable.

cases.subject: LootDropService
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Caller owns rejected/prepared detached Nodes; successful registration transfers ownership. Failure paths free once, pending/reservation caches are Component-owned and clear/rebuild. Four actual drops per cycle and repeated restore tested.

cases.subject: HazardLifecycle
cases.ownership_and_verdict: PROVEN independent baseline use-after-free: remove_entity immediately frees detached Node, then queue_free touched freed instance. Fixed by returning after World removal; unregistered queue_free remains.

cases.subject: O_RemoveOnHealthDepleted / package destruction
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Detached actors are rejected by EntityAvailability; callbacks can only queue destruction of registered in-tree Nodes. Similar-looking queue_free is not a proven detached UAF; kept.

cases.subject: NpcPopulationQueries / NpcRouteSolver / CustomerFlowQueries / LightCircuitService
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Single current-World caches disconnect world_changed and clear queries/references at handoff. Weak containers are keyed by current roster/authored circuits, not a new entry per lookup.

cases.subject: KinematicImpactCapture
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Replaces contact_bodies with current collision set every capture, not cumulative WeakRef append.

cases.subject: InteractionControlFocus / NpcAttackService
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Tokens erase on release or expired owner; animation callables bind weak actor/state to avoid Component->Callable->Component cycle, with generation validation and disconnect on finish.

cases.subject: CustomerNpcLifecycleBinding
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Native body owns signal lifetime; weak actor/World bindings deduplicate same-World installation and validate current World/registration at callback.

cases.subject: GameSessionService
cases.ownership_and_verdict: One pending snapshot/level, replaced for a handoff and cleared at consume/failed scene change; no accumulating snapshot array. Detached scene probes are Nodes freed by caller.

cases.subject: SaveDataCodec / InputPromptCatalog / GameSettingsService / NpcLightingService
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Closed Script schema, finite authored texture paths, finite settings keys and one SceneTree/revision are bounded process services; no per-World actor retention or manual RefCounted destruction.

cases.subject: OrderDeliveryService / C_District
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Goods/body references are derived maps of corresponding receipts/roster, cleared/rebuilt on restore/world lifecycle. Durable terminal history is explicit domain data, not described as an orphan; changing history retention would be product scope.

cases.subject: Factory failures and UI cleanup
cases.ownership_and_verdict: Production free targets are typed Node/Entity scene instances or UI children; pre-registration failure ownership remains caller, live destruction follows native World/scene lifecycle. UI rows/labels queue deletion; label arrays remove expired entries and enforce maximum.

cases.subject: Queued Systems/Observers
cases.ownership_and_verdict: CommandBuffer callbacks retain bounded captured Components/records until flush, weak Node witnesses and exact identity/generation checks reject stale work; purge/end World releases queued callbacks. No reference()/unreference() calls found.

conclusion: One reproduced independent UAF repaired. No free(RefCounted/Resource) or further proven ownership defect found in reviewed significant sites. Static scan and scenario tests are not a universal proof for all runtime paths.
